scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p packages/ce/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/playground/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/ui-showcase/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run --filter @ga-ut/ce build && bun run --filter @ga-ut/ui build && bun run build:compat && bun run --filter @ga-ut/ce-playground build && bun run --filter @ga-ut/ui-showcase build
scripts.build:compat: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R packages/ce/dist/. dist/
scripts.pack:check: bun run --filter @ga-ut/ce pack:check && bun run --filter @ga-ut/ui pack:check
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.verify:full: bun run verify && bun run test:events && bun run docs:validate && bun run pack:check
